values.note: Recreation.gov's seasons run first-come from late April, reservable mid-May to early September, then first-come to mid/late October. The FS page says late May to September, as weather allows.

season.source: recreation.gov rate seasons 2026 (04-23..10-18) and 2027 (04-23..10-24) + fs.usda.gov 'Seasons of Use Late May - September, as weather and conditions allow' and 'Site Closed', read 2026-11-27

note: Humboldt-Toiyabe NF (Bridgeport RD) campground on an open sagebrush bench under scattered Jeffrey pines at 7,000 ft, below the Sawtooth Ridge in the Twin Lakes area SW of Bridgeport. Robinson Creek runs through the trees just west, and Lower Twin Lake is a walk away. Paved roads and spurs. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov 232367 read. $30 single confirmed, +$6 extra vehicle. 21 sites + group (27 was note prose), max 45, paved. Vault -> flush toilets + potable water.
